response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack software engineer with 19+ years of experience, he lacks the critical mandatory technical requirements for this role. He has only ~6 months of professional C++ experience (vs. required 5-10 years), no Windows platform development background, weak SQL expertise without SQL Server/Oracle knowledge, and zero capital markets or investment banking domain experience. His career has consistently focused on web, mobile, and geospatial development rather than financial systems or systems programming.
strengths: 19+ years of professional software development experience demonstrating senior-level technical capability and proven ability to rapidly learn diverse technology stacks across multiple domains
Strong communication and mentorship skills evidenced by multiple technical talks, workshops, and demonstrated software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pair programming)
Experience with real-time, low-latency, high-throughput systems (Dunnhumby's millions of requests/second infrastructure) showing ability to optimize performance-critical applications
concerns: Critically insufficient C++ experience: only ~6 months of professional work in 2014-2015, far below the required 5-10 years; C++ not even listed in current skills
No demonstrated Windows platform development experience and complete absence of capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income domain knowledge—both mandatory requirements

Weak and outdated SQL expertise with no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle proficiency; recent 5 years focused on NoSQL (MongoDB) and TypeScript/Node.js web development rather than relational database systems
